column7: Review of #3631: keyorix_bump_role_permissions_generation() and keyorix_secret_nodes_bump_cache_epoch() resolved their operators through the writing session search_path. A session whose search_path put a schema with a bigint + integer operator ahead of pg_catalog (set by the session, or for every session by ALTER DATABASE/ROLE ... SET from a role that owns them) made direct writes move neither role_permissions_generation nor cache_epoch, with no catalog change on the triggers or functions for the integrity check to see. Both functions now pin search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp, the integrity check expects exactly that proconfig, and the installers converge an older unpinned function on the next boot. Also TestSecretNodeCacheEpoch_WriterSearchPathCannotShadowTheBump_Postgres, TestRolePermGeneration_FunctionPinsSearchPath_Postgres, TestSecretNodeCacheEpoch_FunctionPinsSearchPath_Postgres.
